units: Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 28 (ed. Vien. יַגַּח Af.).—
B. Kam. 47ᵃ כי נַגְחָהּ at the time he gored her; a. e.—נ׳ קרבא to wage war.
Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 10 (v. גִּיחַ).—Part. pass. נְגִיחַ breaking through, flowing over.

B. Bath. 68ᵇ דנ׳ קאיהו לגיו Ms. M. (ed. קאיהי; Rashb. דנגח; Ms. F. a. R. דנגחקייהו in one w., Ar. דנגהק׳, corr. acc.) when their outlet runs inside of the township (v. קָאיָיא, cmp. גִּיהָא).—Trnsf. enough (cmp. דַּי).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>לא … בתיגריה נְגִיחָא לך</he> ed. Ven. (v. Rashi a. l.) have you not enough (that I escorted you thus far)? attend now to your business yourself; v. <cite ref="N00127"><he>נְגַהּ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 44:6">Targ. Ps. XLIV, 6</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 21a">B. Kam. 21ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 48a:17">Sot. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַגַּח כי תורא</he> he butts like an ox.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 13:5">Tosef. Sot. XIII, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>לאַגָּחָא קרבא</he> to wage war.
<cite ref="Niddah 65b:35">Nidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>דמַגְּחֵי וכ׳</he> Var., v. <cite ref="C00690"><he>גִּיחַ</he></cite> a. <cite ref="N00127"><he>נְגַהּ</he></cite>.
